series.name: England vs India ODI Series 2026
series.notes: ODI leg of India's tour of England 2026. Fixtures: 1st ODI 14 Jul (Edgbaston, Birmingham), 2nd ODI 16 Jul (Sophia Gardens, Cardiff), 3rd ODI 19 Jul (Lord's, London). The 5-match T20I leg (1-11 Jul) is already complete. India ODI captain: Shubman Gill; England captain per current squad.
